name: BIG-Bench Hard (BBH)
description: A benchmark of 23 challenging tasks from BIG-Bench selected for performance substantially below human-level results, covering diverse language understanding and reasoning abilities.
citation: Suzgun, M., Scales, N., Schärli, N., et al. (2022). Challenging BIG-Bench Tasks and Whether Chain-of-Thought Can Solve Them. arXiv:2210.09261. https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.09261

license.notes: The upstream repository does not specify a standard SPDX license for the dataset; the identifier above is descriptive, not an SPDX identifier. Review upstream terms and the terms of the underlying BIG-Bench tasks before use or redistribution.
